_about: Per-zone proximity settings: the defaults a zone gets for what it does not set, and the allowed values. Read by the module (zone_defaults.py: Settings, rules.py) and by the app (app/zones.py, by path), so the zone editor and the pipeline cannot drift. Tuned in Ticket 3 (2026-11-01): best F1 on labelled site footage, chosen on one half and checked on the other; see products/proximity/README.md. Ticket 6 (2026-11-04): the depth check is on by default, each zone with its own cut-off (depth_max_gap 0.25: on Ticket 3's labelled close pairs it keeps 87 % of the real near misses and drops 25 % of the false ones; 0.2 kept 77 % and dropped 37 %).
